title: Fragments of the Ancient Magnet
description: This cartographer's map shows three ancient pools where magnetic fragments were hidden. The fragments, when assembled, create a magnet powerful enough to break the magnetic lock on the chest I found in the pyramid. Search the islands' ancient pools using a magnet to find all three fragments.
fishingTip: Search the islands for ancient pools like the one beneath this pyramid. Use a magnet (forge one with the Toolmaster if needed) to find the fragments hidden in treasure chests.

objectives.description: Collect all 3 fragments of the ancient magnet from the ancient pools marked on the map

rewards.description: The Explorer assembles all three fragments into the complete Ancient Magnet.
